auth.title: Money, together.
auth.description: One shared view of our life and goals, with room for each of us to breathe.
auth.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.confirmEmail: Check your inbox to confirm your email, then sign in.

household.title: Let's set up our space
household.description: One of us starts the household, then invites the other with a code.
household.name: Household name
household.currencyHint: Everything is tracked in this currency. Timezone: {{timezone}}
household.inviteHint: Your partner can find this on their home screen.

home.connectedDescription: You and {{name}} now share this space. Anything either of you logs to the Shared Bucket shows up for both of you straight away.
home.comingNextDescription: Next we'll set our incomes, guilt-free allowances and the shared costs we cover together.

invite.title: Invite your partner
invite.description: They create an account, choose "Join my partner", and type in this code.
invite.message: Join our household on {{appName}} with this code: {{code}}

proportional.label: Proportional
proportional.description: We each chip in based on what we earn. Recommended.

equal.label: Equal (50/50)
equal.description: We split shared costs down the middle.

combined.label: Fully combined
combined.description: All our money goes into one pot and is treated as ours.

setup.title: Connect {{appName}} to Supabase
setup.description: The app needs a Supabase project to store your household. This screen disappears once it's connected.
setup.createProject: Create a free project at supabase.com.
setup.environment: Copy .env.example to .env.local and paste in your project URL and publishable key (Project Settings → API).
setup.migration: Run the SQL in supabase/migrations on your project.

validation.displayName: What should your partner call you?
validation.currency: Use a 3-letter currency code, like USD or ZAR

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.alreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a stronger password with at least 8 characters.
errors.rateLimited: We've had a few requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.signInRequired: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.alreadyInHousehold: You're already part of a household.
errors.invalidTimezone: We couldn't use that timezone. Please check your device settings.
errors.inviteNotFound: That invite code didn't match any household.
errors.householdFull: This household already has two partners.
errors.notHouseholdMember: You no longer have access to this household. Please sign in again.
errors.budgetChanged: Our plan changed on another device. Reload the latest plan before saving again.
errors.invalidBudget: We couldn’t save those amounts. Check the fields and try again.
errors.budgetEarlierSteps: Save the earlier budget steps before finishing.
errors.paymentUnavailable: This payment is no longer available.
errors.paymentChanged: This payment changed on another device or was already paid. Reload it before trying again.
errors.invalidPayment: We couldn’t save that payment. Check the amount, dates, category and payer.
errors.paymentTypeFixed: This payment’s visibility and recurrence can’t be changed. Create a new schedule instead.
errors.paymentCyclePaid: That cycle is already paid. Choose the next unpaid cycle.
errors.paymentState: This schedule can’t be changed to that state.
errors.categoryUnavailable: That category is unavailable. Choose an active category visible in this space.
errors.categoryChanged: This category changed on another device. Reload the latest data before saving.
errors.invalidCategory: We couldn’t save that category. Check the name, emoji and reporting bucket.
errors.categoryVisibilityFixed: A category’s visibility stays fixed. Create a new category to change it.
errors.chooseReplacement: Choose a different active replacement category before archiving.
errors.expenseUnavailable: That expense is no longer available in this space.
errors.expenseChanged: This expense changed on another device. Reload it before saving.
errors.linkedFrequencyFixed: This expense’s frequency follows its linked scheduled payment.
errors.forecastUnavailable: This forecast item is unavailable. Return to the calendar and refresh.
errors.forecastChanged: Someone changed this item. Return to the calendar to reload before editing again.
errors.invalidForecast: Check the dates and amounts. Shared contributions cannot exceed known income, and received money cannot have a future date.
errors.incomeUnavailable: This private income entry is unavailable. Return to My income to refresh.
errors.invalidExpense: Check the expense details and amounts before retrying.
errors.queuedExpenseChanged: This identifier may already have been saved with different details. Check the expense list before creating another entry.
errors.queueFull: There are 100 expenses waiting on this device. Sync or review them before adding more.
errors.receiptUnavailable: This receipt is unavailable for this account.
errors.receiptPending: The photo has not finished uploading yet.
errors.receiptTooLarge: Choose a receipt photo smaller than 5 MB.
errors.receiptMissing: The saved photo is missing from this device. Choose a replacement in Pending expenses.
errors.cameraPermission: Allow camera access in device settings, or choose an existing receipt photo.
errors.deviceStorage: Device storage is unavailable or full. Free some space and try saving again. Keep existing app data.
errors.householdCurrencyChanged: The household currency changed. Review the actual charge in the current currency before retrying.
errors.commentUnavailable: That comment is no longer available to change.
errors.commentChanged: This comment changed. Refresh the conversation and review the latest version before trying again.
errors.invalidComment: Write a comment of 1 to 1,000 characters.
errors.invalidReaction: Choose one of the available reactions.

budget.title: Our budget, together
budget.description: A simple plan for our shared life, with room for each of us.
budget.incomeDescription: Each of us enters our own monthly take-home income. Use an average if it changes.
budget.waitingIncome: The ratio and contributions will be ready once both of us have entered our income.
budget.incomeVisibility: Your monthly total is shared. Individual income sources and payday details stay private.
budget.allowancesTitle: A little room for each of us
budget.allowancesDescription: Agree on a monthly guilt-free allowance for each partner. Either of us can adjust these shared amounts.
budget.costsDescription: List our usual monthly shared costs. These are planned amounts; payment dates come when we add bills.
budget.emptyCosts: No monthly costs yet. Add one below, or continue with an empty plan.
budget.costLimit: We can add up to 50 shared costs.
budget.sourceLimit: We can add up to 10 income sources.
budget.leftAfterPlan: Left after allowances and shared costs
budget.overPlan: Our plan is more than our current income. We can adjust the amounts together.
budget.paydaysDescription: Add your own payday schedule. Your partner sets theirs on their device. Multiple sources and irregular income are welcome.
budget.dateHint: Monthly repeats on this day; weekly every 7 days; biweekly every 14 days. Short months use their last day.
budget.irregularDateHint: Leave the date or amount empty if it is not known yet.
budget.paydayPrivacy: Only you can see these source names, amounts and payday dates. Our split still uses the monthly income from step 1.
budget.saveHint: Each step saves when we continue. We can come back to it later.
budget.loadError: We couldn’t load our budget setup.
budget.reloadHint: Reloading replaces unsaved edits with the latest saved plan.
budget.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount in {{currency}}, using your local decimal separator.
budget.invalidPositiveAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero in {{currency}}.
budget.invalidName: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
budget.invalidDate: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
budget.requiredDate: Add the next payday, or choose irregular.
budget.checkStep: Check the highlighted fields before continuing. The plan total must also stay within the supported amount limit.
budget.notStarted: Let’s add our incomes, allowances, shared costs and paydays.
budget.partnerPending: Your part is saved. Your partner still needs to finish their own setup.
budget.summaryDescription: These are planned monthly amounts. Spending and scheduled payments will be tracked separately.
budget.joiningTitle: Your partner has started our plan
budget.joiningHint: Review the shared agreement, then add your own income and payday details. Shared changes affect both partners; private income sources stay yours.
budget.incomeWhy: Your monthly total helps calculate a fair share. You can enter zero if you currently have no income.
budget.allowanceWhy: This is the amount each person can spend privately each month. Zero is allowed; you can agree a new amount later.
budget.costWhy: Add monthly amounts you already know. These are budget plans, not scheduled bills or logged expenses. You can continue with no cost lines and add them later.
budget.paydayOptional: Optional: paydays make the forecast more useful. You can set them up later without guessing an amount or date.
budget.deferHint: This keeps any saved income sources. The forecast will still show missing income until you add it.
budget.pendingTotals: The full household total and leftover will be available after both partners enter their income.
budget.firstSuccess: You can start with one real expense or an upcoming bill. Setup and guides can wait.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: A clear view of what’s due, what’s paid and who’s covering it.
payments.name: Payment name
payments.variableHint: Leave this empty for a variable bill. We’ll estimate from the last three payments.
payments.privacyHint: Private payment names, amounts, notes and history are visible only to you.
payments.fixedType: Visibility and recurrence stay fixed after creation. Create a new schedule to change either.
payments.dateHint: Dates follow {{timezone}}. Monthly windows must stay within one calendar month.
payments.reminderHint: Reminders use the start of a date window, at 9 am in {{timezone}}.
payments.transactionHint: Logging creates a shared or private expense with the actual date, amount and payer.
payments.deleteQuestion: Delete this schedule? Its payment history and logged expenses will stay.
payments.empty: No payments here yet. Add a bill or subscription to see what’s coming up.
payments.noHistory: Paid payments will appear here, even after their schedule is deleted.
payments.notFound: This payment is no longer available. It may have been deleted or made unavailable.
payments.reloadWarning: Reloading replaces unsaved edits with the latest saved payment.
payments.invalidName: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
payments.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero in {{currency}} using your local decimal separator.
payments.invalidDates: Enter real dates as YYYY-MM-DD, with the end on or after the start. Monthly windows must stay within one month.
payments.checkFields: Check the fields, choose a category and payer, then try again.
payments.reminderDeviceHint: Only your own upcoming payments can trigger a reminder. Lock-screen messages never include names, amounts or notes.
payments.reminderLocalLimit: This device queues the next 50 unpaid payment reminders. Open the app to refresh after changes on another device.
payments.reminderWeb: Device notifications are available in the iOS and Android app. Upcoming payments are shown here in the browser.
payments.reminderDenied: Notifications aren’t enabled. You can allow them in device settings and try again.
payments.reminderFailed: We couldn’t update this device’s reminders. Reopen the app and check notification settings.
payments.reminderBody: One of your payments is coming up. Open {{appName}} to check it.
payments.monthlyAnchor: Monthly days: {{startDay}}–{{endDay}}. Short months use their last day; longer months restore these days.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Organise our spending in a way that makes sense to us. Categories and reporting buckets can change as our life does.
categories.name: Category name
categories.emojiHint: Use the emoji keyboard to choose a label, or leave this empty.
categories.bucketHint: Buckets group categories for reports. They don’t change an expense’s amount or payment schedule.
categories.empty: No categories in this view yet.
categories.privateHint: Private custom names and their spending are visible only to you. Shared categories can also be used for your private expenses.
categories.sharedHint: Both of us can create and edit shared categories. Using one for a private expense keeps the expense itself private.
categories.fixedVisibility: Visibility stays fixed after creation. Create a new category to change where a name is shared.
categories.archiveHint: Always choose a replacement category. Existing expenses and schedules move together; private items and usage counts are never shown. Paid history keeps its original category name.
categories.noReplacement: Create another eligible category before archiving this one.
categories.invalidName: Enter a category name of 1 to 40 characters.
categories.invalidEmoji: Choose a shorter emoji label (up to 16 characters).
categories.checkFields: Check the name and emoji, then try again.
categories.reloadHint: Reloading replaces unsaved edits with the latest saved values.

expenses.title: Review expenses
expenses.description: Review the category and frequency of expenses already logged. Shared entries belong to us; private entries stay yours.
expenses.frequencyHint: Monthly is a reporting label. Add a scheduled payment to plan future cycles; this label does not create another expense.
expenses.linkedHint: The frequency follows the linked payment. You can still change this expense’s category; paid history keeps its original snapshot.
expenses.empty: No logged expenses here yet. Mark a payment paid and choose “Also log this expense” to add one.

cashflow.title: Our cash-flow calendar
cashflow.loadError: We couldn’t load the calendar. Check the connection and that the cash-flow migration has been applied.
cashflow.needBalance: Start with a confirmed shared closing balance to see a forecast.
cashflow.lowWarning: The balance may fall to {{amount}} before the next expected contribution. Review what is due together.
cashflow.estimateHint: A 90-day estimate, based on entries and plans. Same-day commitments are reserved before expected income. Amounts may change.

gaps.staleBalance: Update the closing balance before using this forecast. It must be within the last year.
gaps.budgets: Some monthly costs have no category link. Link them in Balance and budget coverage to include their remaining spend.
gaps.unknownPayment: A payment has no known amount or payment history. The forecast is incomplete until you enter an estimate.
gaps.lateIncome: An expected contribution is late. It is shown on the calendar but excluded from available money until confirmed or moved to a new date.
gaps.income: There is no upcoming shared contribution. Add a contribution from My income, or review it with your partner.
gaps.scheduleLimit: A payment schedule has over 600 unpaid cycles. Review its paid history and next due date before using this forecast.

cashflow.window: Due window ends {{date}}; reserved from the first day.
cashflow.lateIncome: Late and unconfirmed · excluded from available money
cashflow.emptyDay: No entries or plans for this day.
cashflow.overdueHint: These are reserved immediately after the closing balance, or today if later. Mark the payment paid if already covered.
cashflow.goalHint: A shared reservation for a future goal contribution. This does not record a transfer or track a savings balance.
cashflow.reload: Return to calendar and reload before editing again
cashflow.balanceHint: Enter the shared account’s closing balance after all activity on the selected date. Only later logged activity changes this balance. Check it again when entries are missing.
cashflow.dateHint: Use YYYY-MM-DD. Dates follow the household timezone.
cashflow.budgetHint: Link each monthly cost to a shared category. The calendar reserves only the remaining plan after that month’s logged spending, pending bills and goal reservations. Several lines in one category are combined. New monthly cost lines need a category link.
cashflow.correctionHint: This change is shared with your partner and affects this occurrence only. It does not change the original schedule or record a payment. Income corrections adjust the daily expected total, never confirm a transfer.
cashflow.optionalHint: Leave empty to use the original date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, today or within the next 180 days.
cashflow.optionalAmount: Leave empty to keep the original estimate. Enter zero to reserve nothing.
cashflow.unavailable: This forecast item is no longer available. Return to the calendar to refresh.
cashflow.incomePrivacy: Source names, individual payday amounts and entries are visible only to you. The calendar receives only daily totals of contributions you explicitly share. The monthly income total used for your budget split remains shared.
cashflow.nearIncomeHint: Showing the last 31 days and next 90 days, plus undated entries.
cashflow.allIncomeHint: Showing generated and saved occurrences. Older confirmed history is kept.
cashflow.noIncome: No income entries here yet. Add an irregular entry, or set up your payday schedule.
cashflow.contributionConsent: Choose the amount you expect to put into shared funds each payday. Your partner will see its date and daily total. Your source name and full pay stay private. Set zero for future unedited paydays to share nothing. Individual corrections and received history are kept when this rule changes.
cashflow.delayHint: Zero means the same day. This changes future unedited expectations only.
cashflow.incomeEntryHint: Correct just this occurrence, or add a bonus or temporary income change. Your original payday schedule stays the same.
cashflow.dateOptional: Leave empty for irregular income with no known date. Otherwise use YYYY-MM-DD.
cashflow.amountOptional: Leave empty if the amount is not known.
cashflow.entryConsent: Only the shared contribution amount, date and transfer status below are shared. Receiving your salary does not confirm a transfer into shared funds. Set zero to keep this occurrence entirely private.

dashboard.incomePending: The income total is provisional until both partners have entered their monthly income.
dashboard.overPlan: Our logged spending is {{amount}} above this month’s plan. We can review it together.
dashboard.noPlan: No shared monthly plan yet. Add our costs to see what remains.
dashboard.budgetHint: Net logged spending this month, including refunds. Scheduled bills and goal reservations appear in the cash-flow forecast.
dashboard.allowances: A little room for each of us
dashboard.allowancePrivacy: Allowance totals are shared. Private purchases stay private.
dashboard.sharedOnly: Shared payments in the next 90 days, plus unpaid earlier commitments. Open All payments for your private bills.
dashboard.noPayments: No pending shared payments in this forecast.
dashboard.unknownCommitments: Some commitments have unknown amounts. They are additional to the total above.
dashboard.forecastGaps: Some forecast details still need attention. Open the calendar to review its coverage.
dashboard.forecastHint: An estimate from the calendar’s 90-day forecast. Expected contributions are not confirmed money.
dashboard.noActivity: No shared expenses yet. Logged activity will appear here.
dashboard.loadError: We couldn’t load this part of Home. Check the connection and try again.

quickLog.title: Log an expense
quickLog.queueHint: Entries saved on this device for your account. They sync while the app is open and connected. A receipt can finish uploading after its expense is saved.
quickLog.editUnavailable: This entry is syncing, already saved, or no longer available. Check Pending expenses before logging it again.
quickLog.linkHint: Saving also marks the cycle due {{date}} paid. Its amount is logged once. If that cycle changes before sync, we’ll ask you to review it.
quickLog.foreignHint: Enter the amount actually charged in {{currency}} above, then keep the original currency and amount below. Exchange rates are not fetched automatically.
quickLog.photoHint: Enter the receipt details above. Photos upload after the expense is saved; private photos stay private.
quickLog.savedHint: The expense is saved. Your budget and history will refresh.
quickLog.queuedHint: Saved on this device. Keep the app data and open the app when connected to finish syncing. Retry uses the same identifier to prevent duplicates.
quickLog.receiptPendingHint: The expense is saved. Only its receipt is still waiting to upload. Retrying will not add another expense.
quickLog.reviewHint: This entry needs review before it can sync. Its currency, category, payer or linked payment may have changed. Open the entry and check the details.

status.pending: Saved on device · waiting to sync

quickLog.scheduleHint: This expense is already logged. The new schedule starts next month by default; choose the next unpaid date before saving.
quickLog.cached: Using this device’s last saved categories and payments. Changes on another device will be checked when this entry syncs.
quickLog.storageError: We couldn’t read or update this device’s saved entries. Keep the app data and retry. A new entry is saved only after device storage succeeds.
quickLog.invalid: Check the amount, description, category, payer and real date. The date must be today or within the past ten years. A linked payment must still be available.
quickLog.receiptError: We couldn’t load this receipt. Check the connection and try again.
quickLog.noReceipt: No receipt photo is available for this expense.
quickLog.offlineHint: Your session could not refresh while offline. You can draft expenses for the last account used on this device. Queued expenses stay on this device until an authenticated session is restored.
quickLog.noOfflineCatalogue: Connect once to load this account’s household, categories and payments before logging offline.
quickLog.currencyChanged: The household currency changed. Enter the actual amount in the current household currency before saving again.

sharedBudget.title: Our shared budget
sharedBudget.description: Our monthly plan and spending, shared between us.
sharedBudget.categoryHint: Remaining means the assigned monthly plan minus logged spending. Bills below are shown separately.
sharedBudget.notAssigned: No plan assigned to this category yet.
sharedBudget.unassignedHint: These costs are included in our monthly total. Assign them to categories to see each category’s remaining budget.
sharedBudget.emptyCategories: Add a shared category to organise our spending.
sharedBudget.actualHint: Logged shared expenses and refunds for this month. Future entries count on their date.
sharedBudget.futureHint: Future-dated expenses are excluded until their date arrives.
sharedBudget.paymentHint: The next unpaid cycle per shared schedule, within 90 days, including overdue bills and cash-flow corrections. Expected bills do not count as spent until an expense is logged.
sharedBudget.loadError: We couldn’t refresh our shared budget. Try again to see current totals.
sharedBudget.assignHint: Connect the monthly costs from our budget setup to shared categories. Several costs can contribute to the same category.
sharedBudget.noCosts: Add shared monthly costs in our budget setup first.
sharedBudget.allocationRefreshError: We couldn’t refresh the saved assignments. Your choices are still here. Try again to reconnect.

privateSpace.title: My private space
privateSpace.privacy: Your spending and private payment details stay yours. Your partner sees only allowance totals.
privateSpace.over: This month’s entries are {{amount}} above the allowance.
privateSpace.balanceHint: Refunds reduce spending. Future-dated entries in this household month also count toward the allowance. Pending bills count only when an expense is logged.
privateSpace.paymentHint: The next five unpaid private payments within 90 days, including overdue bills.
privateSpace.noPayments: No upcoming private payments in the next 90 days.
privateSpace.spendingHint: Your ten latest entries by expense date, including future-dated entries. Open all spending for older entries.
privateSpace.noExpenses: Your private spending will appear here after your first entry.
privateSpace.loadError: We couldn’t refresh this part of your private space. Try again.

conversation.title: About this shared expense
conversation.sharedHint: Only our household can see this conversation. Your private expenses stay private.
conversation.empty: No comments yet. A small thank-you can go a long way.
conversation.bodyHint: Up to 1,000 characters. Comments need a connection; unsent text stays in this open form.
conversation.confirmRemove: Remove your comment? Its text will be removed for both of us.
conversation.loadError: We couldn’t refresh this conversation. Your draft is still here. Try again.
conversation.unavailable: This shared expense is no longer available.
conversation.changedEdit: This comment changed on another device. Your draft is still here.
conversation.adoptHint: Review the saved text first. Saving your draft will replace it.
conversation.adoptEdit: Keep my draft and use this version
conversation.changedRemoval: This comment changed. Review the latest text before removing it.
conversation.alreadyRemoved: This comment was removed elsewhere. You can copy your draft before closing the editor.

design.chartHint: Arcs show positive net spending by category. Refunds remain included in the totals and category amounts below.

guides.title: Guides
guides.description: Short walkthroughs using your own household. Skip, close or replay any guide. Financial changes always need your own action.
guides.useControl: Use this screen’s controls to complete the step.
guides.localError: Guide progress could not be saved on this device. You can continue; try saving again from Guides in Settings.
guides.syncError: Guide progress has not synced. Local progress stays on this device; retry from Guides in Settings when connected.

firstVisit.title: Show me around
firstVisit.description: Find Shared, Private and your first expense in four short steps.
firstVisit.homeBody: See this month’s shared spending against the plan. Income stays provisional until both partners enter it.
firstVisit.sharedBody: Our plan, spending and remaining budget, by category. Both partners can review shared expenses.
firstVisit.privateBody: Your purchases, categories and receipts stay private. Only allowance totals are shared.
firstVisit.logBody: Use Log expense below to open the form. Choose Shared or Private before entering a real expense.

quickLog.title: Log an expense
quickLog.description: Choose who can see an expense, then save it with an amount and category.
quickLog.spaceBody: Shared entries are visible to both partners. Private entries are visible only to you; your partner sees your allowance total. Choose a space below.
quickLog.saveBody: Enter an amount and category, then Save expense. Open More details for a bill link, note, receipt or foreign currency. Offline saves stay queued until connected.
quickLog.resumeBody: Choose Shared or Private again to reopen the form and continue this guide. Your guide progress is saved; unsaved expense form values are not.
quickLog.changeBody: To choose a space again, use Start again in another space at the end of this form. Changing spaces clears unsaved form values. The guide never changes visibility for you.

payments.title: Schedule a bill
payments.description: Set an exact date or a payment window, with an optional amount for variable bills.
payments.listBody: Scheduled bills are commitments, not logged spending. Shared bills are visible to both partners; private bills stay with their owner. Next opens a new, unsaved bill.
payments.createBody: Choose visibility, payer, category and an exact date or date window. Leave the amount blank for a variable bill. Use Save payment when ready; this guide never saves or marks a bill paid for you.

cashflow.title: Read the cash-flow calendar
cashflow.description: Distinguish confirmed money from expected money, then explore a day.
cashflow.forecastTitle: A forecast needs a starting balance
cashflow.forecastBody: The forecast combines your shared closing balance, approved income contributions, bills and plans. Missing information stays unknown. Set a closing balance separately if needed; a forecast is an estimate.
cashflow.calendarBody: Select a date in the calendar below to see its items. Confirmed and expected amounts are labelled. Correcting a forecast item does not change its original schedule.

categories.title: Organise categories
categories.description: Keep shared labels and your own private labels separate.
categories.spacesBody: Shared categories are editable by both partners. Private category names remain yours. Categories also use needs, wants or savings for reporting. Next opens a new, unsaved category.
categories.createBody: Choose Shared or Private, enter a name and select a reporting bucket. Save when ready. This creates a label only; it does not move or log money.

budgetCategories.title: Assign planned costs
budgetCategories.description: Connect monthly cost lines to categories without changing their amounts.
budgetCategories.planBody: A category plan comes from the monthly cost lines assigned to it. Unassigned costs still count in our total plan. If there are no costs yet, add them in budget setup first.
budgetCategories.assignBody: Choose a category for a cost below and save the assignment. No money moves. If a partner changes the plan first, reload explicitly and review the latest version before trying again.
budgetCategories.emptyBody: There are no monthly cost lines to assign yet. Open budget setup below and save a cost, then return here and resume this guide. No category assignment is available until a cost exists.

privateAllowance.title: Understand my allowance
privateAllowance.description: See what your allowance means and what stays private.
privateAllowance.balanceTitle: Your allowance is for your month
privateAllowance.balanceBody: Remaining is your monthly allowance minus your logged private spending. Refunds reduce spending. Unpaid private bills are shown separately and do not reduce it until an expense is logged.
privateAllowance.privacyBody: Your partner receives allowance totals only, never private purchase details or receipt photos. Use All my private spending to review your entries. Review allowance opens the shared budget agreement; no changes happen just by opening it.

guides.closed: Guide closed. You can continue using this screen.

welcome.title: Welcome to Couple Goals
welcome.description: A quick introduction to our shared and private spaces.
welcome.spacesTitle: Shared money. A space of your own.
welcome.spacesBody: Shared expenses belong to both of you. Private purchases stay yours; your partner sees only your allowance totals.
welcome.connectTitle: Start together, or start on your own
welcome.connectBody: Create a household or join with your partner’s code below. You can set up the budget now and invite your partner later.

phase18.quickLogDetails: Payer, bill link, note, receipt and foreign currency
phase18.noCategories: No matching categories. Your current selection is unchanged.
phase18.saveHint: Saved on this device first. Sync status appears after saving.
